source_document: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (G.S.R. 202(E), Dept of Consumer Affairs)

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 10, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer (including city, state, and PIN code).
Common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) & Rules 11, 12, 13, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Net quantity in standard unit of weight (g/kg), volume (ml/l), length (m/cm), or number (N/U). Words like 'when packed' or 'approx' are prohibited.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 2(m), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Maximum Retail Price in the format 'MRP Rs. ... / ₹ ... incl. of all taxes' or 'Maximum / Max. retail price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes'.

rules.field: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) & Rule 6(1) Explanation I, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Month and year in which commodity is manufactured, pre-packed or imported expressed in words or numerals (MM/YYYY or Month Year).
Name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 10(1) Proviso, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Country of origin must be declared, especially for imported goods or commodities pre-packed in India with foreign origin.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(e) Amendment, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules
rules.description: Unit sale price (e.g. ₹ per g / ml / piece / kg) mandatory for pre-packaged commodities where package contains more than 1 piece or net qty > 1g/1ml.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) Proviso & FSSA/Food/Cosmetics Rules, Legal Metrology Rules
rules.description: Expiry date or Best-Before period mandatory for perishable food, cosmetics, or therapeutic commodities.

rules.rule_reference: Rule 7 & Table-I, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Numerals and letters of net quantity declaration must meet minimum height requirements based on net weight or volume.
Exempts packages containing commodities net content 10g/10ml or less (except tobacco), packages containing fast food items packed by hotel/restaurant, and agricultural produce in packages > 50kg.

Whoever manufactures, packs, imports or sells non-standard packages shall be punished: 1st Offence: Fine up to ₹25,000; 2nd Offence: Fine up to ₹50,000; Subsequent: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year or both.
